content.title:
Exam-day checklist.
*Pack it tonight.*
content.subtitle: Five things to sort the day before, so exam morning is calm.

steps.title: Admit card, printed
steps.detail: Print it and read every instruction on it, including reporting time and what you may carry.

steps.title: A valid photo ID
steps.detail: Carry the ID your admit card asks for. Keep it with the admit card.

steps.title: Know the route
steps.detail: Check where the centre is and how long it takes to reach. Plan to arrive early.

steps.title: Sleep, not a last mock
steps.detail: Light revision only. A full mock the night before tires you out.

steps.title: Your first-10-minutes plan
steps.detail: Decide now which section you open first and how you will skip hard questions.

content.saveLine: Send it to a friend writing IIM B UGAT.

caption:
Pack this tonight, thank yourself on exam morning 👇

3. Know the route
4. Sleep, not a last mock
5. Your first-10-minutes plan

Always follow the instructions on your admit card.
